metadata.case_name: SAN-TO, PO YUK HITLER v. WING KWONG PAINTING COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: part time employment at Oliver's (March 2003, resigned after ~6 weeks)

injuries.description: Significant disc extrusion at L4/5 causing severe spinal canal narrowing
source: A Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) carried out on 15 August 2000 showed significant disc extrusion at L4/5 causing severe spinal canal narrowing. Hypertrophic changes of the apophyseal joints and ligamentum flava contributed to the degree of spinal canal narrowing.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Mild postero-central disc bulge at L5/S1 level that caused moderate spinal canal stenosis / mild left posterolateral disc protrusion at L5/S1
source: There was also mild postero-central disc bulge at L5/S1 level that caused moderate spinal canal stenosis.
When the further MRI was performed on 29 June 2002 it showed posterior disc protrusion at L4/5 and mild left posterolateral disc protrusion at L5/S1
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: left lower limb pin and needle sensation from buttocks to thigh
not being able to stand or sit for over 25 minutes without change in posture
local tenderness at the midline and left side associated with left side paraspinal muscle spasm
back motion range limited by pain at end-range
complaint of numbness over the outer side

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency treatment at Ruttonjee and Tang Shiu Kin Hospital
Outpatient treatment at United Christian Hospital
Physiotherapy (22 February to 19 June 2000 and 9 November to 3 December 2000)
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans (15 August 2000; 29 June 2002)
treatments_future: spinal fusion (recommended by Dr Lam if pain arose from injured L4/5)
surgical treatment (recommended by Dr Danny Tsoi)

losses.description: Prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5 with severe spinal canal narrowing and L5/S1 disc protrusion resulting in back injury and left sciatica
Unable to stand or sit for over 25 minutes without change in posture; reduced back motion and limited tolerance for prolonged weight bearing or sitting
Inability to continue as a painting worker pursuing advancement to master painter and need to seek alternative lighter duties employment
